newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SOCCER-MCGRATH, KELLY BACK IN IRELAND SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MCGRATH, KELLY BACK IN IRELAND SQUAD.

text.p: Ireland manager Mick McCarthy on Tuesday named Derby County's veteran defender Paul McGrath in his 20-man squad for the friendly international against Wales in Cardiff on February 11.
McGrath, 37, last played for Ireland when he won a record 82nd cap in the 2-0 defeat by the Czech Republic in Prague last April.

There was also a call up for Leeds United full-back Gary Kelly, who has not played for Ireland since the European championship play-off qualifier against the Netherlands at Anfield in November 1995 because of injury and a dip in form.
